headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a surprising upset in the Bronx, defeating the New York Yankees 5-3. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs. In other news, the Boston Red Sox snapped the Baltimore Orioles' winning streak with a 6-3 victory, while the Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Toronto Blue Jays placing Patrick Corbin on the 15-day injured list due to a left teres major strain. The Blue Jays also transferred Addison Barger to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation and placed Jonatan Clase on the 10-day injured list with left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles placed Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres and the Houston Astros trading Max Martin to the Kansas City Royals. The Los Angeles Dodgers also acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies, while the Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the New York Yankees 5-3, handing the Yankees their first loss of the series. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout victory. Max Fried led the Pirates' pitching effort with 5.0 innings of scoreless work, striking out 7 batters.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including a crucial single that scored Coby Mayo.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 6-5 in a closely contested game. Impact players on both teams included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith, while Chris Sale stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Steven Kwan and Patrick Bailey were key contributors for the Guardians, while Gavin Williams had a strong outing for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal is reportedly for future considerations.
